[[File:TarsisKrall.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Tarsis'Krall'']]
The '''''Tarsis'Krall''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that crashed in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a group of prisoners escaped from the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] with the help of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and fled into the desert. [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Vengo]] activated the prisoners' [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collars]], forcing them to take shelter in the ruins of the ''Tarsis'Krall'' and tend to the injured.
